name: Fieldnote

source.note: A made-up brand used only to test the machinery. Replace this folder with a real brand pack.

mission: Fieldnote makes notebooks for people who work outdoors.

strategy.title: Useful before beautiful.
strategy.body: Every product decision starts from what survives a wet pocket.

strategy.title: Plain words.
strategy.body: We describe what a thing does. We do not describe how it makes you feel.

principles: Name the material and the measurement.

art_direction.title: In use
art_direction.intro: Hands, weather and worn objects. Daylight only. Nothing staged on a clean surface.
art_direction.role: Shows the product doing its job
art_direction.covers: Product, field work, people at work

art_direction.title: Material
art_direction.intro: Close studies of paper, thread and cloth, lit from one side.
